Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred the team's division based on the conference (ACC) rather than the specific division structure of the NCAA in 2006. In 2006, the NCAA did not use "Coastal Division" as a formal divisional label for the ACC; the ACC was a single division within Division I-A (now FBS). The "Coastal Division" terminology was introduced later (around 2005-2006 for the Big East, but the ACC remained a single division until realignment changes much later). By stating the team was in the "ACC Coastal Division," the Planner provided a factually incorrect classification of the division, failing to verify the specific NCAA divisional structure of that year.
